create_AveragedModel: create a Stochastic Weight AveragedModel wrapping a PyTorch module for SWA or EMA parameter averaging
create_SWALR_scheduler: create a SWALR learning rate scheduler that anneals to a fixed SWA learning rate with cosine or linear strategy
build_update_bn: build batch normalization statistics by running one data pass through the model to update running_mean and running_var
